'''Story Mode''' is the main mode of the game, with each World being different iconic Anime locations. They reward the Player items and Gems, and your Units receive XP to level up. For every level completed for the first time, you receive an extra 60 Gems in addition to the completion reward.[[File:StoryMode.png|thumb|400x400px|center]]


<tabber>
|-|Planet Namak=
== Planet Namak ==
Planet Namak '''(Planet Namek)''' from Dragon Ball Z, is the first World of Story Mode. This Map consists of a fairly long path. Each act you complete in this World grants you '''Senzu Beans''' for your units and Gems.

|-|Shiganshinu District=
== Shinganshinu District  ==
Shiganshinu District '''(Shiganshina District)''' from Attack on Titan, is the second World of Story Mode. This Map features a complex looking path and introduces new Enemies with '''Buffs'''. Each act you complete in this World grants you '''Mysterious Fluid''' for your units and Gems.

== Snowy Town ==
Snowy Town from Demon Slayer, is the third World of Story Mode. This Map has a short path and one curve around the center of the path. Each act you complete in this World grants you '''Wisteria Flower''' for your units and Gems.
